mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tianquan_oauth.oauth_subject_revocation_task (id, tenant_id, version, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id, deleted_at, identity_sub, target_tenant_id, source_revision, subject_enabled, reason_code, status, next_attempt_at, attempt_count, lease_owner, lease_until) VALUES (#{task.id}, #{task.tenantId}, 0, #{now}, #{actor}, #{now}, #{actor}, NULL, #{task.identitySub}, #{task.targetTenantId}, #{task.sourceRevision}, #{task.subjectEnabled}, #{task.reasonCode}, 'PENDING', #{now}, 0, NULL, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, version, identity_sub, target_tenant_id, source_revision, subject_enabled, reason_code, status, next_attempt_at, attempt_count, lease_owner, lease_until FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_subject_revocation_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until <= #{now})) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tianquan_oauth.oauth_subject_revocation_task SET status = 'LEASED', lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{until}, attempt_count = CASE WHEN attempt_count < 2147483647 THEN attempt_count + 1 ELSE attempt_count END, version = version + 1, update_user_id = #{actor}, update_time = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{task.id} AND version = #{task.version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until <= #{now}))
